info.title: Civil Situation Map API
info.summary: Documentation-first OpenAPI skeleton for the civil situation map.
info.description: API baseline for ingest, situation queries, subscriptions, source registry, symbology, audit, AI assistance, health and metrics. The API supports situational awareness and data interoperability only; it does not define targeting, weapon control or use-of-force workflows.

servers.description: Relative server URL for local, test and deployed environments.

get.description: Returns the Keycloak/lab actor identity plus server-side COP workspace, map, replay and alert preferences for the authenticated operator.

put.description: Persists only display, workspace, replay and informational alert preferences. This endpoint does not create tasking, targeting or weapon workflow state.

get.description: Authenticated operator lookup for adding COP community group members. Results expose canonical OIDC subject ids plus display handles; clients must persist `subjectId`, not usernames or email addresses.

Single startup endpoint for iPhone/iPad clients. It returns safe public mobile configuration, user profile, map settings, endpoint discovery, capabilities and the current policy-filtered read-only COP snapshot.

parameters.name: includeAcknowledged
parameters.description: Include acknowledged informational alerts in the snapshot.

get.description: Returns the same policy-filtered read-only COP data used by bootstrap, without profile/config metadata. Native clients store this in encrypted device storage and must mark it stale according to cachePolicy.

Returns the authoritative COP map catalog. The catalog groups user-facing layers independently from provider internals, separates technical inputs from citizen-visible layers, and preserves provider/source provenance for diagnostics and future providers.

parameters.name: includeDiagnostics
parameters.description: Include diagnostic layers and source inputs. Ignored for unauthenticated public-read requests.

parameters.name: includePartner
parameters.description: Include partner/private layers such as TAK Gateway. Ignored for unauthenticated public-read requests.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Preferred label locale.

get.summary: Proxy an allowlisted georeferenced raster overlay image.
get.description: Returns a client-safe raster image for catalog layers with kind=raster_overlay. Browser and native clients must use this COP endpoint for provider raster URLs returned by /api/v1/map/query instead of calling SIM or external weather providers directly. ČHMÚ radar layers must use the SIM clean raster URL from providerProperties.raster.url; rawUrl and sourceUrl are diagnostic only. COP accepts allowlisted absolute URLs and SIM clean relative paths under /api/v1/weather-radar/clean/.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Percent-encoded raster URL from providerProperties.raster.url. May be an allowlisted absolute URL or a SIM clean radar relative path such as /api/v1/weather-radar/clean/merge1h/frame.png.

502.description: Upstream raster provider failed or returned non-image content.

get.summary: Return server-side SIM weather radar frame catalog.
get.description: Returns a short-lived, client-safe frame catalog for radar playback. COP calls SIM server-to-server and clients use the cleanUrl values only through /api/v1/map/raster-overlay. Browser and native clients must not call SIM weather-radar or ČHMÚ URLs directly.

502.description: SIM weather radar frame catalog is unavailable.

get.summary: Proxy an allowlisted SIM weather webcam detail or snapshot resource.
get.description: Returns client-safe ČHMÚ webcam detail JSON or snapshot image using only URLs supplied in providerProperties.camera.detailUrl or snapshotUrl. COP allows configured SIM hosts and blocks direct chmi.cz upstream hosts.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Percent-encoded weather camera detailUrl or snapshotUrl from providerProperties.camera.

200.description: Weather camera detail JSON or snapshot image.

502.description: SIM weather camera resource is unavailable or returned invalid content.

get.summary: Return CHMI weather station detail through COP.
get.description: Server-side proxy for the SIM situation-data CHMI weather station detail endpoint. Clients derive detailUrl from providerProperties.display.detailUrl and call COP API, so browsers and native clients do not need direct SIM connectivity. COP treats SIM display/charts as authoritative presentation data and does not infer weather state from raw metrics.

parameters.name: nocache
parameters.description: Diagnostic cache bypass forwarded to SIM when set to 1.

200.description: CHMI weather station detail with SIM-prepared current display, history, forecast and charts.

502.description: SIM situation-data weather station detail is unavailable.

get.summary: Return SIM weather forecast area detail through COP.
get.description: Server-side proxy for the SIM situation-data weather forecast area detail endpoint. Clients derive detailUrl from providerProperties.weatherForecast.detailUrl and call COP API, so browsers and native clients do not need direct SIM connectivity. COP renders SIM-prepared summary, current state and charts without inferring weather state from raw weather codes.

parameters.name: nocache
parameters.description: Diagnostic cache bypass forwarded to SIM when set to 1.

200.description: Weather forecast area detail with SIM-prepared summary, current display, forecast series and charts.

502.description: SIM situation-data weather forecast area detail is unavailable.

get.summary: Return public transit vehicle detail through COP.
get.description: Server-side proxy for the SIM situation-data public transit vehicle detail endpoint. Clients derive detailUrl from providerProperties.transit.detailUrl and call COP API, so browsers and native clients do not need direct SIM or city-provider connectivity.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional SIM transit source id such as pid_gtfs_rt or a future city adapter.

parameters.name: nocache
parameters.description: Diagnostic cache bypass forwarded to SIM when set to 1.

200.description: Public transit vehicle detail with SIM-prepared route, stop list, realtime status and service alerts.

502.description: SIM situation-data transit vehicle detail is unavailable.

get.summary: Return public transit stop detail through COP.
get.description: Server-side proxy for the SIM situation-data public transit static stop detail endpoint. Clients derive detailUrl from providerProperties.transit.detailUrl and call COP API, so browsers and native clients do not need direct SIM, GTFS, or city-provider connectivity.

parameters.name: systemId
parameters.description: Normalized transit system id from providerProperties.transit.systemId.

parameters.name: stopId
parameters.description: Normalized transit stop id from providerProperties.transit.stopId.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional SIM transit source id, typically public_transit_static.

parameters.name: departuresLimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of nearest departures requested from SIM.

parameters.name: nocache
parameters.description: Diagnostic cache bypass forwarded to SIM when set to 1.

200.description: Public transit stop detail with SIM-prepared served routes, nearest departures, data quality and warnings.

502.description: SIM situation-data transit stop detail is unavailable.

get.summary: Search public places for map navigation.
get.description: Returns client-safe geocoding results for map navigation. COP calls the configured geocoder server-side and caches repeated searches so web and native clients do not need direct external geocoder access.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Place query, for example "Kyjev" or "Praha".

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Preferred result language passed to the provider.

post.summary: Query source-neutral map features.
post.description: Single public COP feature query endpoint. Clients select catalog layer IDs from /api/v1/map/catalog; COP translates those layer IDs to internal provider queries server-side. Provider-specific SIM endpoints are not part of the COP public API.

get.summary: Return CHMI hydro station observation detail through COP.
get.description: Server-side proxy for the SIM safety-data CHMI hydro station detail endpoint. Clients derive stationId and query parameters from SafetyFeatureProperties.detailUrl and call COP API, so browsers and native clients do not need direct SIM connectivity.

502.description: SIM safety-data hydro detail is unavailable.

get.summary: Return SIM per-BTS mobile coverage viewshed through COP.
get.description: Server-side proxy for the SIM situation-data per-BTS viewshed endpoint. Clients call this only after a user selects one communication tower/BTS reference; COP must not call it in bulk for all towers. Prefer a SIM-provided viewshed tower id or clean {osmType}:{osmId}; legacy COP map feature ids are normalized defensively. The response is a model estimate, not confirmed operator/NOC BTS status.

404.description: The selected object does not support mobile viewshed calculation.

502.description: SIM situation-data mobile viewshed detail is unavailable.

post.description: Pilot endpoint for native COP device/session policy and audit. This is not the APNs push registry. Production push tokens are registered with CSM Messaging /api/v1/devices; COP does not send APNs pushes and does not persist raw APNs tokens.

get.description: Returns derived data-quality conflict evidence for current COP objects. Evidence may include affiliation variance, lifecycle variance, source position variance, low confidence, degraded source health and object states already marked as conflicted. This endpoint is informational only and does not provide targeting or action recommendations.

parameters.name: objectIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated object IDs. When omitted, current objects are evaluated.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Evaluate recent history newer than this many seconds from server time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum retained points per object used for evidence.

parameters.name: includeExpired
parameters.description: Include tracks older than the configured active display lifecycle.

get.description: Returns derived informational alerts from current COP tracks, server-side conflict evidence and source health. Alerts support operator acknowledgement, but do not provide tasking, targeting or weapon workflow.

parameters.name: includeAcknowledged
parameters.description: Include alerts already acknowledged by an operator.

parameters.name: includeExpired
parameters.description: Include alerts derived from tracks outside the active lifecycle window.

post.summary: Acknowledge an informational COP alert.

get.summary: Query policy-filtered temporal history for COP tracks.
get.description: Returns retained server-side temporal history points for one or more tracks. The result is intended for timeline/replay and route-history visualization; it is not an action or targeting workflow.

parameters.name: objectIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated object IDs. When omitted, all retained track histories are returned.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Keep only points newer than this many seconds from server time.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum retained points per object returned by this request.

get.summary: Read COP snapshot for a subscription.
get.description: Returns the current subscription snapshot. The live browser stream is exposed at /api/v1/stream/cop/live.

get.summary: Open live COP Server-Sent Events stream.
get.description: SSE stream that emits a policy-filtered snapshot, object delta messages from accepted ingest events, and heartbeat messages. Clients authenticate with the standard Authorization bearer header.

get.summary: Read COP stream health and backpressure metrics.
get.description: Operational health for the live COP stream. This endpoint reports distribution metrics only; it does not expose targeting or action workflow.

Ask the AI COP assistant for allowed data assistance.
post.description: AI assistance is limited to explanation, summarization, query help, data quality and documentation support.

post.summary: Create a server-side AI situation summary from current readable COP data.
post.description: COP builds a bounded, policy-filtered context from current objects, alerts and source health, then calls the configured server-side AI provider.

post.summary: Explain provider/source health using the server-side AI assistant.
post.description: Summarizes stale, degraded or partial provider states without exposing internal tokens or raw diagnostics to the browser.

post.summary: Draft and improve a community report using server-side AI.
post.description: Assists with title, description, category and missing-field questions from user-provided report metadata. Media content is not read by this endpoint.

get.description: Server-side capability and health bridge for the standalone CSM Messaging service. The browser must not call the messaging provider directly or receive service tokens.

post.summary: Create client-safe Matrix bootstrap for the authenticated user.
post.description: Authenticated COP users may request a short-lived Matrix user token for direct Matrix client-server communication with E2EE. This endpoint never returns provider, service or Synapse admin tokens and does not proxy plaintext messages.

200.description: Matrix bootstrap state for the authenticated user.

get.summary: List CSM Messaging conversation metadata for the authenticated user.
get.description: Server-side metadata bridge to CSM Messaging. It returns conversation metadata only; no plaintext message content is stored or proxied by COP.

200.description: Conversation metadata visible to the user.

post.summary: Create CSM Messaging conversation metadata.
post.description: Creates only metadata, members and optional map links. Plaintext message fields are rejected; real messages go directly through Matrix SDK.

502.description: Upstream provider did not create conversation metadata.

post.summary: Synchronize safe conversation members with CSM Messaging.
post.description: Metadata-only bridge used after COP community group membership changes. It forwards member identifiers/display metadata only and rejects plaintext message fields.

502.description: Upstream provider did not synchronize conversation members.

post.summary: Resolve COP/CSM users to Matrix user IDs through the Messaging provider.
post.description: Server-side identity resolution used only for Matrix room invitations. The response never contains passwords, service tokens or Matrix access tokens for other users.

post.summary: Store or ensure the Matrix room binding for a Messaging conversation.
post.description: Stores Matrix room metadata only. COP still does not proxy or persist plaintext chat messages. An empty JSON body is accepted as an ensure/bind request for native clients when CSM Messaging can return an existing or server-created room binding.

502.description: Upstream provider did not accept the room binding.

get.description: Returns public browser Web Push capability data for the COP web/PWA client. The response never contains provider service tokens, APNs keys, VAPID private keys or messaging credentials.

post.summary: Register this browser for Web Push
post.description: Registers an authenticated browser/PWA Web Push subscription through COP. COP validates the request and forwards it server-side to CSM Messaging device registry. The browser never receives COP_CSM_MESSAGING_TOKEN or any provider credential.

202.description: Device registration accepted or safely degraded.

502.description: Messaging provider degraded or unavailable.

delete.summary: Unregister a browser Web Push device
delete.description: Deletes an authenticated browser/PWA Web Push registration through COP. COP forwards the request server-side to CSM Messaging without exposing provider credentials to the browser.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Stable COP browser device id generated by the web client.

202.description: Device deletion accepted or safely degraded.

502.description: Messaging provider degraded or unavailable.

post.summary: Evaluate SIM safety features for citizen push notification dispatch.
post.description: Authenticated server/operator endpoint used by COP to decide whether safety features from SIM are relevant to the current user, explicit audience or watched areas. By default this endpoint is a dry run. When dryRun=false, COP submits only minimized notification metadata to CSM Messaging through server-to-server notification intake. COP never stores APNs tokens and never sends push directly.

200.description: Notification decisions and optional dispatch results.

502.description: CSM Messaging notification intake was degraded for one or more dispatches.

post.summary: Register or update a federated node heartbeat.
Publish a COP domain event.
post.description: Accepts CloudEvents-compatible domain event commands into the local COP event log. This pilot runtime is an append-only broker facade; external broker transport is added in a later ADR.

post.summary: Flush offline edge outbox events
post.description: Accepts a bounded batch of CloudEvents-compatible domain events produced by a registered edge-node. The server enforces producer identity from nodeId and returns per-item accepted, duplicate, or rejected status.

207.description: Outbox flush processed with only rejected items.

get.description: Returns the durable replay acknowledgement cursor for a registered edge-node. Missing cursors default to offset 0.

post.summary: Acknowledge edge replay cursor
post.description: Stores the highest replay offset durably processed by an edge-node. The stored cursor is monotonic and will not move backwards.

post.summary: Re-drive a dead-letter domain event
post.description: Publishes a corrected dead-letter event back into the domain event log and marks the dead-letter as redriven. COP does not create another dead-letter for invalid re-drive payloads; the operator receives a validation error instead.

post.summary: Resolve a dead-letter domain event
post.description: Marks a dead-letter as resolved without publishing a replacement event. Use when the rejected payload is intentionally discarded or superseded externally.

get.summary: Replay policy-filtered domain events for an edge node
get.description: Returns CloudEvents-compatible domain events visible to a registered edge-node. The default offset comes from the durable edge replay cursor; explicit fromOffset may be supplied for recovery. Events blocked by classification or release policy are not returned.

get.summary: Describe the COP MCP protocol endpoint.
get.description: Returns client-safe metadata for the stateless MCP Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC endpoint. The endpoint exposes only read-only allowlisted COP tools.

post.summary: Call the COP MCP JSON-RPC endpoint.
post.description: Implements the MCP JSON-RPC methods `initialize`, `notifications/initialized`, `ping`, `tools/list` and `tools/call` over a stateless HTTP endpoint. Tool calls reuse the audited COP allowlist and publish `MCP_TOOL_INVOKED` audit events.

get.description: Returns the allowlisted COP tool registry. The registry is client-safe metadata only; it does not expose provider tokens or arbitrary execution.

post.summary: Invoke an audited read-only COP MCP tool.
post.description: Invokes a server-side allowlisted read-only COP tool and publishes an ai.tool.invoked audit domain event. The endpoint never proxies plaintext messages, Matrix provider tokens or arbitrary commands.

get.description: Served by the optional cop-edge-node runtime when it is published under /edge. This endpoint only confirms that the edge process is running.
Returns degraded when the local edge runtime is alive but cannot synchronize with central COP.

200.description: Edge runtime is ready or degraded.

get.description: Returns local file-backed edge runtime state, recent replayed events and local dead letters. The edge runtime never calls SIM directly; it synchronizes only with COP central API.
Returns the same local status envelope as /edge/status, with recentEvents bounded by the optional limit query parameter.

post.summary: Trigger local edge synchronization.
post.description: Admin-only local command. Flushes the local edge outbox, pulls policy-filtered central replay and acknowledges the replay cursor after durable local write.

post.summary: Queue a local edge outbox event.
post.description: Admin-only local command for pilot edge integrations. Queues a domain event command locally for later flush through central COP /api/v1/edge/outbox/flush.

HistoryLimitQuery.name: limit
HistoryLimitQuery.description: Maximum number of history points returned per object.

IncludeExpiredQuery.name: includeExpired
IncludeExpiredQuery.description: Include tracks older than the configured active display lifecycle.

BadRequest.description: Bad request or schema validation error.

subjectId.description: Stable lab identity or OIDC subject claim.
Canonical OIDC subject id to persist in group membership.

workspaceSkin.description: Visual skin for the web workspace. Templates may set this together with layout and map preferences.

avatarDataUrl.description: Small data URL avatar generated by the client. Server accepts PNG, JPEG or WebP data URLs up to 250 kB.

groupId.description: COP community group used as the event context and default media ACL target.

groupName.description: Human-readable group name copied into report metadata for map and mobile clients.

metadata.description: May include media ACL under metadata.access.

accessDenied.description: Present in map/list responses when the caller may see the report but not the media object.

contentUrl.description: Relative COP API URL for reading uploaded media. Present only after upload completion and only when the caller is authorized for the media object.

derivatives.description: Derived media objects, for example XR side-by-side video generated from iPhone Spatial MOV.

contentUrl.description: Relative COP API URL for reading the derived media. Present only when ready and authorized.

anchorLocation.description: Optional primary event location for map display of the group. Report-created groups use the first report location.

metadata.description: Safe application metadata merged into the existing community group metadata. Chat clients store only conversation and Matrix room identifiers here, never plaintext messages.

sidc.description: Optional APP-6/NATO SIDC for professional mode. COP does not use this for targeting or weapon workflows.
Present only for professional APP-6/NATO symbols.

dataBase64.description: Base64 encoded file data. Used as HTTPS-safe fallback when direct browser PUT to object storage is unavailable.

availability.description: Provider-reported availability. The value 'disabled' means the layer is not offered as a normal map choice.

compatibilityOnly.description: True when the layer is only a fallback/compatibility projection and should be hidden while preferredProviderId is online with the same layerId.

disabledReason.description: Human-readable reason why a disabled layer is not offered in the normal map catalog.

preferredProviderId.description: Provider that should be preferred over this compatibility layer when available.

compatibilityOnly.description: True when the source is only a fallback/compatibility projection for a preferred provider.

preferredProviderId.description: Provider that should be preferred over this compatibility source when available.

styleUrl.description: Optional MapLibre style URL. When present, clients should prefer it over the raster tile template.

pushToken.description: Deprecated compatibility field. COP does not persist raw APNs tokens; CSM Messenger must register them with CSM Messaging /api/v1/devices.

fireStatus.description: Fire-specific status such as risk, thermal_anomaly, active, confirmed, contained, or unknown.

dataQuality.description: Data provenance quality such as modelled, observed, mixed, or unknown.

readModel.description: True when the provider returned a prepared read model instead of an ad-hoc viewport estimate.

sourceRevision.description: Provider technical model/source revision string for diagnostics.

sourceIncident.description: Source-specific incident classification, for example CHMI_CAP_FIRE_DANGER or NASA_FIRMS_HOTSPOT.

detailUrl.description: Relative SIM safety-data detail URL for CHMI hydro station observations.

timelineUrl.description: Compatibility alias for the hydro station observation timeline URL.

discharge.description: Current discharge in m3/s when available.

waterTemperatureC.description: Current water temperature in Celsius when the station publishes TH.

floodStage.description: Flood activity level, where 0 means no SPA and 1-3 are Czech SPA levels.

forecastAvailable.description: True when CHMI provides H_F or Q_F forecast series for the station.

WeatherDisplayPresentation.description: SIM-prepared weather presentation. COP renders these fields directly and must not infer weather state from raw metrics when they are present.

iconKey.description: Presentation icon key prepared by SIM, for example measurement, rain, snow, fog or station.

conditionMode.description: observed means authoritative CHMI condition; measured means directly measured phenomenon; estimated means SIM inference; unclassified means neutral measurement display.

WeatherStationDetail.description: SIM weather station detail. COP renders current.display and charts[] as prepared presentation output.

TransitVehicleDetail.description: SIM public transit vehicle detail. COP renders route, current status, stop list and service alerts as prepared transit context without calling city upstreams directly.

TransitStopDetail.description: SIM public transit stop detail. COP renders stop metadata, served routes, nearest departures, data quality and warnings as prepared transit context without parsing GTFS or calling city upstreams directly.

chatAvailable.description: True only after a client-safe Matrix/E2EE bootstrap contract is advertised by provider metadata and provider health is operational.

accessToken.description: Short-lived Matrix user token scoped to the authenticated user.

deviceId.description: Stable per-browser Matrix device identifier generated by the client and sent in the request body and as x-csm-device-id to Messaging.

metadata.description: Safe metadata only. Plaintext message fields are rejected by COP and CSM Messaging.
Safe scalar integration metadata, for example source and externalId.

MessagingMatrixRoomBindingRequest.description: Optional roomId binding. Empty object is accepted as an ensure/bind request for native clients.

dryRun.description: Defaults to true. Set false only when COP should call CSM Messaging notification intake.

layerIds.description: Alias for layers. Reference layer boundary_admin is intentionally excluded from push evaluation.

layers.description: Safety layers eligible for citizen notification evaluation.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key passed to CSM Messaging Idempotency-Key when dispatching.

dataEndpoints.description: REST/OpenAPI, GeoJSON/OGC or service endpoints exposed by the node.

eventSubscriptions.description: Event channels or topics the node consumes from the federation backbone.

mcpEndpoint.description: Optional MCP endpoint advertised by the node for read-only agent diagnostics.

nodeTrustDomain.description: Trust boundary used for policy, audit and key ownership decisions.

publicKeyRef.description: Reference to the node public key or JWKS/issuer record.

releaseScopes.description: Scopes that may match event releasePolicy.allowedScopes for edge replay.

status.description: Operator lifecycle status for a rejected domain event.

lastKnownOffset.description: Optional last replay offset known by the edge node before reconnecting.

clientEventId.description: Stable client-generated id used for idempotent retry. If id/eventId is missing, COP uses this value as the CloudEvent id.

lastAckedOffset.description: Highest replay offset durably processed by the edge node. COP stores this monotonically and never moves the cursor backwards.

DomainDeadLetterRedriveRequest.description: Either a corrected domain event publish request or an object with event. Empty body reuses the original dead-letter body.

nextOffset.description: Highest scanned replay offset. Edge nodes should acknowledge this value after durably applying returned items and intentionally skipping filtered events.

id.description: Omit id for JSON-RPC notifications such as notifications/initialized.

input.description: Tool-specific input. If omitted, the top-level object is treated as the input for compatibility with simple callers.

result.description: Tool-specific read-only result. No provider service tokens or plaintext chat payloads are returned.

vapidPublicKey.description: Browser-safe VAPID public key. The private key is never returned.

notificationPreferences.description: Client-declared notification preference hints. Authoritative policy remains server-side.

properties.description: SIM per-sector model properties such as quality, estimatedSignalDbm, confidence, assumptions and DEM/LoS metrics.

tower.description: Selected tower metadata including btsStatus and operatorStatusAvailable when provided by SIM.

summary.description: Model summary and mandatory user-facing disclaimer.

RadioProfile.description: General radio profile. Do not include classified frequencies, COMSEC, callsigns or tactical notes.

properties.description: SIM radio model properties such as score, quality, estimatedSignalDbm, Fresnel and terrain metrics.

capabilities.description: Client capabilities declared by the native app during pairing claim.

encrypted.description: Must be true unless ciphertext is present.

ciphertext.description: Opaque encrypted payload. COP stores metadata only and never decrypts it.
